direction: Calm, warm, confident educator, ~150 wpm. Lead names crisp; a beat after each tap.

lines.text: This is a live 12-lead, on a code simulator.
Tap the ECG and pick any lead. Lead II. V1. aVF.
Or choose all 12 leads, and watch every one sweep live.
Sinus bradycardia, 48 a minute. Slow and regular, with a P wave before every QRS, in every lead.
Now the instructor changes the rhythm. Sinus tachycardia at 108, with an anterior STEMI.
ST elevation in V1 to V4, and in I and aVL.
Now look at III and aVF. The ST goes down. That's the reciprocal change, and you only catch it with all 12 leads on screen.
Pause to freeze the trace. Print for the full 12-lead.
Most code simulators give you one lead. ACLSMED Sim gives you all 12, live.
Practice it on ACLSMED Sim. ACLSmed dot com.
